approvedItems: The script and characters: Maya and Theo, fictional friends, with eight lines (the transcript); no new canon or real people. Approved by Val Alexander on 2026-10-19.
The voices: Kokoro-82M v1.0 synthetic voices af_heart (Maya) and am_liam (Theo), rendered locally; not any real person's voice. Approved by Val Alexander on 2026-10-19.
The music: an original solo piano and bass score in F major, synthesised by scripts/ipic-short/second-score.mjs with no samples, mixed under the speech. Approved by Val Alexander on 2026-10-19.

The likenesses shown: the committed fictional characters Sable (alice, the default guest look) and Rowan (bob, picked in the in-game character picker), and the approved ipic-original-v1 on the screen in the house-lights shot. Approved by Val Alexander on 2026-10-19.

The setting: IPIC's auditorium only, with no lounge floral wall, street frontage or signage; a small window pane shows at the top right of the faces shot. Approved by Val Alexander on 2026-10-19 as shown.
